title: Deep Learning Warm Starts for Trajectory Optimization on the International Space Station
abstract: arXiv:2505.05588v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Trajectory optimization is a cornerstone of modern robot autonomy, enabling systems to compute trajectories and controls in real-time while respecting safety and physical constraints. However, it has seen limited usage in spaceflight applications due to its heavy computational demands that exceed the capability of most flight computers. In this work, we provide results on the first in-space demonstration of using machine learning-based warm starts for accelerating trajectory optimization for the Astrobee free-flying robot onboard the International Space Station (ISS). We formulate a data-driven optimal control approach that trains a neural network to learn the structure of the trajectory generation problem being solved using sequential convex programming (SCP). translated_title: 面向国际空间站轨迹优化的深度学习热启动方法
translated_abstract: 轨迹优化是现代机器人自主性的基石，它使系统能够在满足安全性和物理约束的前提下实时计算轨迹与控制指令。然而，由于其繁重的计算需求超出了大多数飞行计算机的能力，轨迹优化在航天应用中的使用一直非常有限。在这项工作中，我们展示了首次在太空中进行的在轨演示：利用基于机器学习的热启动方法，为国际空间站（ISS）上的Astrobee自由飞行机器人加速轨迹优化。我们提出了一种数据驱动的最优控制方法，训练神经网络来学习使用顺序凸规划（SCP）求解的轨迹生成问题的结构。在星载设备上，训练好的神经网络预测轨迹生成问题的解，并依靠SCP求解器来强制执行系统的安全约束。
tldr: 本研究在国际空间站上首次实现在轨演示，利用神经网络热启动加速Astrobee自由飞行机器人的轨迹优化，通过学习顺序凸规划问题的结构来实现满足安全约束的星载实时轨迹生成。
